# Shirin Shila — Complete Artist Portfolio Context (llms-full.txt)

## Identity
- Full Name: Shirin Akter
- Screen Name: Shirin Shila (শিরিন শিলা)
- Profession: Film Actress, Television Reality Show Judge, Model
- Birth Date: August 26, 1996
- Origin: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Primary Industry: Dhallywood Cinema (Bengali Film Industry)
